item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'set -u
project_dir="$PWD"
tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
cleanup() { rm -rf "$tmp_dir"; }
trap cleanup EXIT

run_ok() {
  name="$1"
  input="$2"
  expected="$3"
  file="$tmp_dir/$name.json"
  out="$tmp_dir/$name.out"
  printf '"'%s' \""'$input" > "$file"
  bun run src/cli.ts plan "$file" > "$out"
  actual="$(tr -d '"'\\n' < \""'$out")"
  if [ "$actual" != "$expected" ]; then
    echo "FAIL success case: $name"
    echo "expected: $expected"
    echo "actual:   $actual"
    return 1
  fi
}

run_fail() {
  name="$1"
  input="$2"
  needle="$3"
  file="$tmp_dir/$name.json"
  out="$tmp_dir/$name.out"
  err="$tmp_dir/$name.err"
  printf '"'%s' \""'$input" > "$file"
  if bun run src/cli.ts plan "$file" > "$out" 2> "$err"; then
    echo "FAIL expected non-zero: $name"
    return 1
  fi
  if [ -s "$out" ]; then
    echo "FAIL stdout not empty: $name"
    return 1
  fi
  if ! rg -F "$needle" "$err" >/dev/null; then
    echo "FAIL stderr mismatch: $name"
    sed -n '"'1,20p' \""'$err"
    return 1
  fi
}

run_ok empty '"'{\"tasks\":[]}' '{\"order\":[],\"layers\":[],\"earliest\":{},\"totalDuration\":0,\"criticalPath\":[]}'
run_ok layers '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"d\",\"duration\":2,\"dependsOn\":[\"b\",\"c\"]},{\"id\":\"c\",\"duration\":5,\"dependsOn\":[\"a\"]},{\"id\":\"b\",\"duration\":3,\"dependsOn\":[\"a\"]},{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":1},{\"id\":\"x\",\"duration\":0}]}' '{\"order\":[\"a\",\"b\",\"c\",\"d\",\"x\"],\"layers\":[[\"a\",\"x\"],[\"b\",\"c\"],[\"d\"]],\"earliest\":{\"a\":{\"start\":0,\"finish\":1},\"b\":{\"start\":1,\"finish\":4},\"c\":{\"start\":1,\"finish\":6},\"d\":{\"start\":6,\"finish\":8},\"x\":{\"start\":0,\"finish\":0}},\"totalDuration\":8,\"criticalPath\":[\"a\",\"c\",\"d\"]}'
run_ok tie_path '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"z\",\"duration\":2},{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":1},{\"id\":\"m\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"a\"]},{\"id\":\"end\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"z\",\"m\"]}]}' '{\"order\":[\"a\",\"m\",\"z\",\"end\"],\"layers\":[[\"a\",\"z\"],[\"m\"],[\"end\"]],\"earliest\":{\"a\":{\"start\":0,\"finish\":1},\"end\":{\"start\":2,\"finish\":3},\"m\":{\"start\":1,\"finish\":2},\"z\":{\"start\":0,\"finish\":2}},\"totalDuration\":3,\"criticalPath\":[\"a\",\"m\",\"end\"]}'
run_ok zero_tie '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"b\",\"duration\":0},{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":0}]}' '{\"order\":[\"a\",\"b\"],\"layers\":[[\"a\",\"b\"]],\"earliest\":{\"a\":{\"start\":0,\"finish\":0},\"b\":{\"start\":0,\"finish\":0}},\"totalDuration\":0,\"criticalPath\":[\"a\"]}'

run_fail invalid_json '{' 'Invalid JSON'
run_fail root_array '[]' 'Input must be a JSON object'
run_fail no_tasks '{}' 'must be an array'
run_fail duplicate_id '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":1},{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":2}]}' 'Duplicate task id: a'
run_fail empty_id '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"\",\"duration\":1}]}' 'non-empty string'
run_fail negative_duration '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":-1}]}' 'finite non-negative number'
run_fail bad_dep_type '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[3]}]}' 'must be a string'
run_fail duplicate_dep '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":1},{\"id\":\"b\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"a\",\"a\"]}]}' 'duplicate dependency: a'
run_fail unknown_dep '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"x\"]}]}' 'unknown dependency: x'
run_fail self_dep '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"a\"]}]}' 'cannot depend on itself'
run_fail cycle '{\"tasks\":[{\"id\":\"c\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"a\"]},{\"id\":\"b\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"c\"]},{\"id\":\"a\",\"duration\":1,\"dependsOn\":[\"b\"]}]}' 'a -> b -> c -> a'

if bun run src/cli.ts nope \""'$tmp_dir/empty.json" > "$tmp_dir/cmd.out" 2> "$tmp_dir/cmd.err"; then echo '"'FAIL unknown command'; exit 1; fi
rg -F 'Unknown command' \""'$tmp_dir/cmd.err" >/dev/null
if bun run src/cli.ts plan "$tmp_dir/empty.json" --bad > "$tmp_dir/flag.out" 2> "$tmp_dir/flag.err"; then echo '"'FAIL unknown flag'; exit 1; fi
rg -F 'Unknown flag' \""'$tmp_dir/flag.err" >/dev/null
if bun run src/cli.ts plan > "$tmp_dir/missing.out" 2> "$tmp_dir/missing.err"; then echo '"'FAIL missing input'; exit 1; fi
rg -F 'Usage:' \""'$tmp_dir/missing.err" >/dev/null
if bun run src/cli.ts plan "$tmp_dir/not-there.json" > "$tmp_dir/file.out" 2> "$tmp_dir/file.err"; then echo '"'FAIL missing file'; exit 1; fi
rg -F 'Could not read' \""'$tmp_dir/file.err" >/dev/null

bunx --bun tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --types bun src/cli.ts

echo '"'SELF_TESTS_OK'
git status --short
git diff --check
git diff -- src/cli.ts README.md"

item.text:
Готово. Реализовала dependency-free Bun/TypeScript CLI в `src/cli.ts` и добавила краткий `README.md`.

Поддержаны валидация входа и аргументов, детерминированная топологическая сортировка, параллельные слои, ранние времена, общая длительность, лексикографически минимальный критический путь и конкретная детерминированная диагностика циклов.

Проверила сборку через Bun и набор смысловых/граничных self-тестов. Все проверки прошли; тестовых файлов в исходном репозитории не было.
